menu_option_descriptions.discover: Scan once for nearby ENTR locks.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Use an address when the lock is not listed.
menu_option_descriptions.import_credentials: Use credentials previously created with the CLI.

no_devices.title: No ENTR locks found
no_devices.description: Move the lock into Bluetooth range, scan again, or enter its address manually.

method.title: Choose how Home Assistant will access the lock

menu_option_descriptions.owner: Take the owner slot. An existing mobile owner loses access.
menu_option_descriptions.user_key: Keep the current mobile owner and redeem a key it created for Home Assistant.

menu_option_descriptions.initialize: Use this only when the lock has never had an owner.
menu_option_descriptions.take_over: Use the current owner admin code. This replaces the mobile app's owner credential.

initialize.title: Initialize a new lock
initialize.description: Use this only for a lock that has not been initialized. Home Assistant will become its first owner.

data_description.admin_code: Choose a six-character code and keep it somewhere safe.

take_over.title: Replace the current owner
take_over.description: Home Assistant will take the only owner slot. The current mobile owner will lose access after this succeeds.

data.confirm_take_over: I understand the mobile owner will lose access

data_description.admin_code: Six-character code for the current owner.

user_key.title: Activate an additional user key
user_key.description: First create a user for Home Assistant with the mobile app or another owner. Redeem its six-character key code here. The mobile owner keeps access.

import_credentials.title: Import existing credentials
import_credentials.description: Paste the JSON exported by the ENTR BLE CLI.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup is already in progress for this lock.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock. Check Bluetooth range and try again.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm that the current mobile owner will lose access.
error.invalid_credentials: Enter valid credentials JSON exported by the ENTR BLE CLI.
error.invalid_input: Check the code and lock name.
error.pairing_rejected: The lock rejected the code or setup method.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between background status reads (lock state, door, battery). Each read briefly connects over Bluetooth and uses some lock battery. Set to 0 to only read after commands and when the lock reappears.
